text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Good morning! What a refreshing morning.
choice_data_list: Looks like you got some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you so much! It was such a 
wonderful day.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
In my dreams, I became the protagonist of 
all sorts of stories~. Fufu, my heart was 
pounding like crazy when I was the lead in 
a horror movie.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Still, every protagonist was strong and 
dignified... Even after waking up, that 
feeling stayed with me, and now I'm 
completely fired up!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Dantsu Flame was able to get a 
proper rest.
